note: Two distinct customs flows are documented for the same legal entity and address (B-21, Shakti Bhawan, Shivaji Colony, Jhotwara): (a) EXPORT confirmed — 5 visible outbound rows to Majan Leading Telecommunication LLC, Muscat, Oman, HS 90011000 (optical fibre cable), Delhi Air, Oct 2024, B/L 4721270 / 4875541; (b) IMPORT confirmed — 20 inbound rows on importkey.com/countries/india/pratap-digital-communications-private-limited, latest 2025-09-16, e.g. "2025-09-08 | SHUANGDENG GROUP CO LIMITED | PRATAP DIGITAL COMMUNICATIONS PRIVATE LIMITED | RECHARGEABLE LI-ION CELL ... 3.2V 100AH | SHANGHAI, CHINA | NHAVA SHEVA SEA, India | 85076000 | 9795436", plus terminal blocks HS 85389000 from Win Hone Industrial (Delhi Air Cargo) marked "FOR MANUFACTURING OF ENERGYSTORAGE SYSTEM (FOR CAPTIVE USE)". Declared HS 854470/900110 matches the export line (90011000) but the company's actual trade mix is broader (85076000 lithium-ion cells, 85389000 terminal blocks) — HS should be recorded as 900110 + 850760 + 853890, not treated as a rejection ground. Profile: importer of cells/components with own assembly and a small but real export channel to Oman; role best described as manufacturer_trader.
